source_credit: D.C. Parker, H.A.G. Houghton and Michael Phelps; EMEL capture, July 2018
source_format: 51 grayscale 8-bit JPEG derivatives, 1533 x 2044; not sensor RAW or full-resolution TIFFs
acquisition_retry: Initial contiguous-block read timed out before publishing any member; successful retry used six bounded payload ranges.

edition.note: There is not enough space for κατα αυτον here. The remaining letters are very unclear.
edition.status: Previously published uncertainty; not a new discovery

processing.selection: All MB and W filename families; Aux, RL, RR, TX excluded before fitting
processing.limitation: Feature-level holdout errors are not letter-level validation; SIFT orientation duplicates are not independent physical controls.

linear_contrast.training_target: Published composite B-G in neighboring line 1

inspection.second_geometry_pass: No defensible narrower anchor or securely attributable new stroke; not blind or independent.
inspection.decision: Improved reproduction of a published contrast, but no securely improved reading of the uncertain phrase. Do not change POB or report a textual breakthrough.
